label: One Dataset, End to End
blurb: One messy dataset taken through every stage: framing, data engineering, cleaning, analytics, statistics, machine learning, deep learning and GenAI, and MLOps, with SQL, pandas, Excel, Power BI and R side by side.
title: One Dataset, End to End: From Raw Data to Decisions
subtitle: A single online-shop dataset analysed in eight stages and in every common tool, with real SQL and Python output, honest results, and a map of which role and which tool fits each stage.
tagline: Taught the IIT Professor Way — Real Numbers. Real Problems. Real Understanding.
appendix_sub: The one-page checklist for the eight stages, the SQL, pandas, Excel and DAX translation table, and the metric definitions used throughout.

chapters.title: Frame the Problem and Meet the Dataset
chapters.sub: From a vague email to ten measurable questions, a data dictionary, loading the data in every tool and the expected answers.

chapters.title: Data Engineering: Ingest, Store, Model and Orchestrate
chapters.sub: Schemas and keys, idempotent loads, indexes, data quality checks and a small scheduled pipeline.

chapters.title: Cleaning, Profiling and Quality in Every Tool
chapters.sub: Duplicates, inconsistent text, missing values, outliers and types, solved the same way in SQL, pandas, Excel, Power Query and R.

chapters.title: Analytics: Aggregation, Joins, Windows, Cohorts and Dashboards
chapters.sub: The same answers in SQL, pandas, Excel and DAX, retention heatmaps, six standard charts and a design checklist.

chapters.title: Statistics and Experiments: Intervals, A/B Tests and Forecasts
chapters.sub: Confidence intervals by hand, scipy and bootstrap, confounding, sample size, the peeking trap and five forecasts on one hold-out.

chapters.title: Machine Learning: From Features to Cost-Based Decisions
chapters.sub: Leakage-safe features and validation, baseline to boosting, thresholds with money, explanations, fairness and a churn model.

chapters.title: Deep Learning and GenAI on the Same Data
chapters.sub: A neural network from scratch, TF-IDF and embeddings, retrieval question answering, safe text-to-SQL and when not to use an LLM.

chapters.title: MLOps and Delivery: Package, Monitor and Decide
chapters.sub: Saving the pipeline, a validated prediction function, drift with PSI, retraining triggers, the decision memo and a role map.
